statement: This sketch renders a deep, muted architectural tapestry that pulses with vibrant neon energy. The composition begins with a subtle grid of interconnected points that flicker and pulse in synchronized waves, creating an impression of a living network. Occasionally, this ambient field resolves into fleeting glimpses of classical and modern architectural forms—rectangles and geometric shapes that shimmer and dissolve back into the luminous web. The visual effect is achieved through layered drawing operations that combine steady pulsing elements with momentary bursts of structured form, all rendered in a muted color palette punctuated by neon glows. The movement is organic yet mathematical, creating a sense of constant transformation within an underlying order.
